lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity white blobs are arranged in vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. A primary column of four distinct nodes is visible between the two main lateral carinae, followed by at least two additional posterior columns forming a staggered geometric lattice.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal ridges to form a grid-like pattern, with circular high-luminance blobs localized at these intersection points across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper and mid-flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge, running parallel to the body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of approximately 10-15 small, circular white blobs, primarily concentrated along the anterior base and lower half of the fin's surface.
dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.other_distinctive_markers: The inter-branchial spaces between the five visible gill slits feature vertical clusters of smaller, high-luminance points distinct in size and density from the primary flank constellation.
